reviews.title: Appointments Are Dropping off
reviews.text:
After noticing appointments are not staying on the app, I asked the Cozi support if there was a way to determine if someone is deleting the appointments or if they are falling off. I was told there isn’t a way to track that information. I have had way too many fall off of the calendar this year. Even though I confirm them with staff after entering them into the calendar. I am choosing not to renew my gold account at this point. No issues until 2026.

Cozi’s response:
Cozi responded to your review of Cozi Family Organizer		
Cozi Family Organizer
Cozi
"Hi, We're sorry for any issues or concerns! Cozi doesn't offer a calendar tracking feature that would enable you to identify who in your account made changes to the calendar or when, and we've reiterated your request that we add this feature in the future. For now, though, any events that you add to the calendar with an online connection will remain in the calendar unless you or someone else in the account manually deletes them. There's no known reason for events that have been saved with an online connection to be deleted other than if someone in the account deletes them. We apologize again for any issues you're having, and if we can help further with this or with anything else please reach us again at cozi.com/contact-us so we can try to help further. Thanks, Cozi"

I confirm my appointments are saved in the app before I leave the office. It has nothing to do with an online connection as these appointments show in the app before I leave the offices (with a wifi connection) and if they are in the app and saved they shouldn’t be randomly falling off the calendar, no issues until it just recently started happening this year. I would have missed my appointments had it not been for a text message from the provider’s office.

reviews.title: Doesn’t play well with digital displays
reviews.text:
I’ve subscribed to Cozi Gold since 2017 and love it, but will be cancelling my account. We have a digital display (Mango Display) and for months Cozi worked great. In February there was an update causing all day events to start at either 11pm the day prior or 4am day of. On very, very rare occasions it displays the start time correctly for a very short amount of time, we are talking a few minutes every few days/ weeks if that. I’ve watched the display flip start times between 11pm the day prior, 4 am day of and the correct all day time within seconds. I reached out to Cozi and their response was the calendar links port into Google Calendar correctly so it isn’t a problem on their end. That instead of selecting all day, time it from 0000 - 2359. Yeah, no. Mango Display cannot find the error on their part. I’ve tried other calendar links with Mango Display and all day events are displayed correctly leading to the belief that it is a Cozi issue. I give up since Cozi is unwilling to try and figure out the error to correct it. To me, it isn’t worth the price since it doesn’t perform how I need it to.


Editing after developer response : 
I initially agreed with your reply that it was a Mango Display issue until I found others using different digital displays that were having the same issue!  If you do a google search, you will find posts from users of other platforms that have their all day events over multiple days due to start time. 
A work-around was adding my cozi calendar to my Google Calendar and having that sync with Mango Display. All day events displayed correctly in both Google Calendar and on my Mango Display. This brings me back to why am I paying for something that doesn’t work how I need it to and I’m using a free option to achieve my goal.

I’ve had this app for about five years. Please listen to this if you plan to use this between your partner and you or your family as your new organization app.

It’s certainly better than having nothing, my partner and I have used it to keep track of our grocery list in real time. 

Before I get into the mini issues, just know that there are better apps. I’m gonna be switching everything over to AnyList. We will see how that goes.

It’s very often that the app has loading issues when everything else works perfectly fine. It’s often slow and when you need it to be in a rush, there’s always a pop-up asking you to upgrade. I suppose that can be pretty normal for a lot of free apps but it just adds to the annoyance when the loading is significantly longer than any other app. We keep having glitches in the system, where it deletes items off our list, or un checks already bought items, confusing the other person to buy things we don’t need. Recently it’s gotten very bad, hence why we were switching everything over. Sometimes we will go to check items off the list and in real time it clicks checked and then a second later clicks unchecked. Like it’s fighting against us to save the data we’re trying to put in. That’s a major issue for an app that is solely focused on real time responsive checking and the information that’s on that list. It puts us in a really tough spot if we’re already out at the store and we’re having a ton of issues with the app because it requires my partner to give me a call and make sure that the things that I put on the list are actually on the list by choice and not buy a glitch. Overall, I hope the app improves, I wish the best of luck to all the people who are working on the app, I’ve just been putting up with this for several years now and it seems to be getting worse. Thank you
